local p = {}

-- Helper function for number formatting
local function formatNumber(number)
    local isNegative = number < 0
    number = math.abs(number)
    
    local formatted = tostring(number)
    local integer, decimal = formatted:match("([^.]+)%.?(.*)$")
    
    local result = ""
    local count = 0
    for i = #integer, 1, -1 do
        count = count + 1
        result = integer:sub(i,i) .. result
        if count % 3 == 0 and i > 1 then
            result = "," .. result
        end
    end
    
    if decimal ~= "" then
        result = result .. "." .. decimal
    end
    
    if isNegative then
        result = "-" .. result
    end
    
    return result
end

function p.calculate(frame)
    local dps = frame.args[1]
    local multiplier = tonumber(frame.args[2] or 1)
    
    local output = ""
    
    -- Only add DPS and DPM if dps is not empty
    if dps and dps ~= "" and not dps:match("{{{%d+}}}") then
        dps = tonumber(dps) or 0
        output = string.format([[
%s

%s]], formatNumber(dps), formatNumber(dps * 60))
    end
    
    -- Only add Total DPS and Total DPM if multiplier > 1
    if multiplier > 1 and dps and dps ~= "" and not dps:match("{{{%d+}}}") then
        output = output .. string.format([[


Total DPS: %s

Total DPM: %s]], 
            formatNumber(dps * multiplier),
            formatNumber(dps * 60 * multiplier))
    end
    
    return output
end

function p.getDPS(frame)
    local dps = frame.args[1]
    if dps and dps ~= "" and not dps:match("{{{%d+}}}") then
        return "DPS: " .. formatNumber(tonumber(dps) or 0)
    end
    return ""
end

function p.getDPM(frame)
    local dps = frame.args[1]
    if dps and dps ~= "" and not dps:match("{{{%d+}}}") then
        return "DPM: " .. formatNumber((tonumber(dps) or 0) * 60)
    end
    return ""
end

function p.getTotalSection(frame)
    local dps = frame.args[1]
    local multiplier = tonumber(frame.args[2] or 1)
    
    if multiplier > 1 and dps and dps ~= "" and not dps:match("{{{%d+}}}") then
        dps = tonumber(dps) or 0
        return string.format([[
Total DPS: %s

Total DPM: %s]], 
            formatNumber(dps * multiplier),
            formatNumber(dps * 60 * multiplier))
    end
    return ''  -- Return empty string if multiplier <= 1 or dps is empty
end

function p.recom(frame)
    local curse = frame.args[1] or ""
    local relics = frame.args[2] or ""
    local traits = frame.args[3] or ""
    
    -- Check if any content exists first
    local hasContent = false
    if (curse ~= "" and not curse:match("{{{%d+}}}")) or
       (relics ~= "" and not relics:match("{{{%d+}}}")) or
       (traits ~= "" and not traits:match("{{{%d+}}}")) then
        hasContent = true
    end
    
    -- Only show header if there's any content
   local output = ""
if hasContent then
    output = "'''Recommended'''"
end
    
    -- Only add sections that have content
    if curse ~= "" and not curse:match("{{{%d+}}}") then
        output = output.."\nCurse: " .. curse
    end
    
    if relics ~= "" and not relics:match("{{{%d+}}}") then
        output = "\nRelics: " .. relics
    end
    
    if traits ~= "" and not traits:match("{{{%d+}}}") then
        output = "\nTraits: " .. traits
    end
    
    return output
end

return p
